purpose: Bounded source-grounded regression cases for the symbolic kernel. These cases test scope discipline, exact combinatorics, provenance handling, and the boundary between source text and model interpretation.
source_claim_boundary: A URL or a short excerpt is not independent source authentication. The Sefaria case is scoped to one displayed textual presentation. The 221/231 scholarly reference is flagged for full-text review; automated tests must not promote it to VERIFIED.

sources.title: Sefer Yetzirah Gra Version 2:4 (Sefaria presentation)
sources.excerpt: Twenty-Two Letters of Foundation: He placed them in a circle like a wall with 231 Gates. The Circle oscillates forward and back.
sources.assertion_scope: This displayed presentation describes 22 foundation letters, 231 gates, and forward/back movement.
sources.scope_limit: Edition-specific report only. This does not establish that every recension has identical wording, that each gate has a unique computational operator, or that WANGA has implemented a verified semantic mapping.

sources.title: Naama Ben-Shachar (2025), bibliographic reference concerning 221/231 gate calculation traditions
sources.locator: Bibliographic record; exact pages and arguments must be reviewed before detailed claims are published.
sources.assertion_scope: A research reference is present for examination of 221/231 variants.
sources.scope_limit: Do not assert the paper's detailed thesis or full evidentiary implications until the article text, source context, and relevant pages are reviewed. The reference is not itself proof.

cases.assertion: For 22 distinct symbols, unordered pairs without self-pairs total 231.
cases.scope_limit: Derived from C(22,2); does not assign semantics to any pair.

cases.assertion: Ordered pairs of distinct symbols total 462.
cases.scope_limit: Derived from 22×21; direction in the representation does not prove different logical meaning.

cases.assertion: Unordered sets of three distinct symbols total 1540.
cases.scope_limit: This is not the number of ordered chains.

cases.assertion: Ordered triples of distinct symbols total 9240; if repetition is allowed, ordered triples total 10648.
cases.scope_limit: The repetition condition must be part of every reported count.

cases.assertion: The selected Sefaria presentation reports 22 letters, 231 gates, and forward/back movement.
cases.scope_limit: Only that presentation; not all textual witnesses or a validated WANGA operator set.

cases.assertion: A 221/231 scholarship reference exists in the source register.
cases.scope_limit: Detailed argument remains not yet reviewed; no universal historical conclusion may be inferred.

cases.assertion: A source-linked input or derivation must not be promoted to VERIFIED solely because a URI exists.
An explicit rule can query the actual K22 gate registry and carry the registry-file provenance in its trace.
cases.scope_limit: The loaded predicate proves a structural pair in the repository dataset only; it does not assign semantic meaning.

cases.assertion: Gate semantic roles remain UNASSIGNED unless a cited source and reviewed mapping are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: A complete combinatorial enumeration is not semantic validation.

cases.assertion: Opposite-polarity claims for one atom trigger REVIEW and are not silently reconciled.
cases.scope_limit: The detector handles explicit atom-level contradiction, not all natural-language contradiction.

cases.assertion: A missing evidence ID makes a claim ineligible as a rule premise.
cases.scope_limit: A present evidence ID alone is not proof that the source supports the claim.
